newsitem.title: CAMEROON: IMF team in Cameroon to finalise adjustment plan.
newsitem.headline: IMF team in Cameroon to finalise adjustment plan.

text.p: An IMF team is arriving in Cameroon on Monday evening to finalise a memorandum of understanding with the government on economic and financial policies, a source close to the finance ministry said.

A letter of intent should be signed at the end of the week, and the International Monetary Fund board should then be in a position to approve a medium-term Enhanced Structural Adjustment Facility in August, the source added.
The ESAF agreement will run for three years until 2000.
Cameroon has previously signed four stand-by agreements with the IMF, but each has fallen through because agreed policies were not maintained.
